verdict.rationale: Porkbun ships an official MCP server ("npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server" with 96 tools) plus a REST/JSON API with agent-oriented docs (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agent-setup guide, sandbox mode, idempotency keys) that an AI-native builder can target, which functions as an official AI-facing interface. However there's no evidence of traditional official client SDKs (Python/Node/Go libraries) — probes for OpenAPI spec and machine-readable docs (porkbun-probe-2, porkbun-probe-3) returned 404s, suggesting no formal SDK/spec artifact beyond raw REST endpoints and the MCP tool wrapper. Missing for 10: dedicated official language SDKs, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
